samples.question: Which cities hosted the Winter Olympics?
replies:

queries.title: Marketing staff with an S in their name
queries.sparql:
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
SELECT ?name ?email WHERE {
  ?p pv:email ?email .
  ?p pv:name ?name .
  ?p pv:memberOf ?d .
  ?d pv:name "Marketing" .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?name, "S"))
}

queries.title: Is there a service for a BOM with parts from Russia? (CK26 question 28)
queries.sparql:
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

ASK
WHERE {
  { # all BOMs with parts from russia
    SELECT ?bom
    WHERE {
      ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
      ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hw .
      ?hw pv:hasSupplier ?suppl .
      ?suppl pv:addressCountry ?country .
      FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?country), LCASE("Russia")))
    }
  }

  # services eligible for parts associated with these BOMs?
  ?s a pv:Service .
  ?s pv:eligibleFor ?hw .
  ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
  ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hw .
}

queries.title: The network expert in the marketing department (CK26 question 10)

queries.title: Suppliers of the most expensive hardware, priced in euros (CK26 question 29)
Winter host cities in Norway after 1950
queries.sparql:
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/olympics#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?city ?year WHERE {
  ?g ex:year ?year .
  ?city ex:hosted ?g .
  ?city ex:country ?k .
  ?k rdfs:label "Norway" .
  ?g ex:season "Winter" .
  FILTER(?year > 1950)
} ORDER BY ?year
